case.title: Google Calendar sync stopped
case.subject: Appointments not showing in Google Calendar anymore
case.text:
Hello,

Since last week new Slotwise appointments don't show up in my Google Calendar. It used to work fine. I changed my Google password recently if that matters. My colleague's sync still works.

Daniel
case.why: Classic sync issue after a password change; the KB says disconnect and reconnect.

output.reply:
Hi Daniel,

Thanks for the details. Changing your Google password is likely the cause, because Google sometimes revokes access after a password change. That would explain why your colleague's sync still works.

Please try reconnecting:
1. Go to Profile → Calendar sync.
2. Click Disconnect.
3. Click Connect Google Calendar and sign in with the Google account that owns the calendar.
4. Allow both permissions (view and edit events), and choose which calendars should block availability.

Changes usually appear within 5 minutes.

If appointments still don't show after reconnecting, reply with your name and an example appointment, and our team can check the sync log.

Slotwise Support
